name: Manmeet Singh Hayer
tagline: Finance & CS graduate · Associate Planner at OneAdvocate Financial · open to FP&A, investment analysis, and fintech roles
lede: I like solving business problems. Need help finding bottlenecks in your funnel conversion? Want to save precious hours by automating a repetitive everyday workflow? Or just need someone who can read and paint a picture from endless rows of marketing/ logistical/ finacial data? I'm your guy.
bio: I'm a business analyst who codes. I've used Python, VBA, SQL, Excel, and BI/ERP tools to turn messy operational data into decisions—budget vs. actuals, variance patterns, unit economics—and built small to large-scale automations that save real hours. Finance & CS graduate of DePauw University (May 2026). Currently Associate Planner at OneAdvocate Financial in Indianapolis, and open to full-time roles in corporate finance/FP&A, investment analysis, and data-heavy product or analytics work.
